notes.title: Cherry CRC Plays our Demo!
notes.notes:
We are constantly updating the demo as we get closer and closer to Explory Story's launch! Today Cherry will check out the changes we've made and enjoy running around Explory Story world!

We look forward to seeing more gameplay from other creators and feedback from our community! Thanks, everyone, for your support so far; we look forward to hearing more from you and showcasing more Explory Story!

If you would like to chat with the developers or get more insight into our development process, join our discord:

https://discord.com/invite/J3x2YkaDNG
